question: Why is 'on_user_turn_completed' the right hook for injecting retrieval context rather than during speech recognition or after LLM generation?
options: Speech recognition runs on a different server and cannot access the vector database
Injecting context during speech recognition would change the transcript
It is the only hook that has access to the vector store connection
It fires after the complete user transcript is available but before the LLM generates a response, providing the ideal window for context injection
explanation: The on_user_turn_completed hook fires at the exact right moment: after STT produces a complete transcript (so you know what to search for) and before the LLM generates its response (so the retrieved context can influence the answer). This timing gives you a clean integration point without modifying the conversation history the user sees.

question: What is the recommended latency budget for the entire retrieval pipeline in a voice RAG agent?
options: No specific budget -- retrieval quality matters more than speed
Under 50ms to match human reaction time
200-400ms, to leave enough time for LLM generation and TTS within the 1-2 second response window
1-2 seconds, since users expect web-like response times
explanation: Voice users expect a response within 1-2 seconds total. The retrieval pipeline (embedding the query, searching the vector DB, filtering) must complete within 200-400ms to leave sufficient time for LLM generation and TTS synthesis. Exceeding this budget creates noticeable pauses in conversation.

question: When should you use static system prompt instructions instead of building a RAG pipeline?
options: When the knowledge is small enough to fit in the context window (under ~4K tokens) and relatively stable
When multiple users need access to different subsets of the knowledge base
When you need to cite specific document sources in your answers
When the knowledge base changes frequently and needs real-time updates
explanation: RAG adds latency and complexity. If your knowledge fits in the system prompt (business hours, basic FAQ, greeting scripts), putting it directly in the instructions is simpler and faster. RAG becomes necessary when the knowledge base exceeds context window limits or changes too frequently for static instructions.

question: Why does the VoiceRAGAgent call Agent.default.on_user_turn_completed (Python) or super.onUserTurnCompleted (TypeScript) at the end of the hook?
options: To log the retrieval results to the console for debugging
To reset the turn context for the next user message
To trigger a second round of retrieval as a fallback
To ensure the default behavior — sending the augmented prompt to the LLM — still executes after context injection
explanation: The on_user_turn_completed hook overrides the default Agent behavior. After injecting your retrieved context via turn_ctx.add_system_message, you must call the parent implementation so the SDK proceeds with its normal flow: sending the augmented prompt to the LLM for generation. Without this call, the LLM would never receive the prompt.
